clips.title: The story
paras: Ur's book now lies in Shadowfang Keep, where Archmage Arugal found it before Forsaken scholars in the Undercity took interest. The Dalaran mage wrote of strange beings from other planes.

Ur was a Dalaran mage known for studying other planes and their creatures. Before the Scourge came, the Kirin Tor knew his work well. Ur was fascinated by magic beyond this world, yet he chose to write down his findings instead of breaking through the veil recklessly. Caution and restraint shaped his research. When the Scourge attacked Dalaran, neither his magic nor his care could save him.
